issuer: the Road Transport and Safety Agency (RTSA)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Road Transport and Safety Agency's site (its certificate chain completed with the missing intermediate, nothing skipped). The Road Traffic Act No. 11 of 2002, in the copy the Agency publishes, s. 64(1)(d): no one may obtain a driving licence or a provisional licence for a motor vehicle not otherwise named (a car) before 18; later amendments weren't read. The Agency's driver licensing page: a provisional driving licence (18 years of age, K117), the practical test (K87, at least 7 days after the provisional licence), and printing of the licence after passing the practical test K144, the fee held. The licence's term isn't given on the page or in the Act's sections read, so validYears is null. Converting a foreign licence costs K348, with the issuing office's or embassy's authentication; no list of countries is given, so no exchange is held. The national registration card is the ids engine's.

sources.title: The Road Traffic Act No. 11 of 2002 (Road Transport and Safety Agency)
sources.said: shall obtain or attempt to obtain a driving licence or provisional driving ... to drive any motor vehicle not mentioned in paragraph (1) ... unless that person has attained the age of eighteen
